question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

We __must acknowledge__ the fact that we __had been__ visited Paris many times with friends.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**had been**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so "**had been**" (past perfect tense) is incorrect.
 
• 
 
The **past perfect tense** is used to indicate that an action was completed or a state of being existed before another action or time in the past.

 
 
• 
 
**Structure**: Subject + had + past participle

 
 
• 
 
**Example**: *She had already finished her homework before the guests arrived.*

 
 
 
 
• The correct verb form to use here would be "**have visited**", which is present perfect tense.
 
• 
 
The **present perfect tense** is used to express actions that happened at an indefinite time in the past, actions that started in the past and continue in the present, or experiences in life up to the present moment.

 
 
• 
 
**Structure**: Subject + have/has + past participle

 
 
• 
 
**Example**:* I have visited Paris several times.*

 
 
 
 
• "**Acknowledge**" and "**must**" are both correctly used in the sentence.
 
• "**Visited**" is also correctly used.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence**: *We must acknowledge the fact that we have visited Paris many times with friends.*
